## LaunchDarkly MCP Server

The launchdarkly MCP server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants and agents to interact directly with LaunchDarkly, the feature management and experimentation platform. It allows AI-driven workflows to inspect feature flags, environments, and targeting rules, helping teams understand feature rollout, experimentation, and risk management without leaving their current tools. This server is particularly valuable for release management, experimentation analysis, and operational decision-making scenarios where feature flag context matters.

tool_definitions.description: Creates a new AI Config within a project. Useful for setting up LLM configurations programmatically.
tool_definitions.name: create-ai-config

tool_definitions.description: Adds a new variation to an AI Config, supporting experimentation or multi-model strategies.
tool_definitions.name: create-ai-config-variation

tool_definitions.description: Creates a new feature flag within a project. AI agents can use this operation to define feature toggles for controlled rollouts, experimentation, or gated features, automating the flag setup process.
tool_definitions.name: create-feature-flag

tool_definitions.description: Deletes an AI Config and its associated variations. Intended for cleanup or deprecation workflows.
tool_definitions.name: delete-ai-config

tool_definitions.description: Removes a feature flag from the project. Used by AI agents to clean up deprecated toggles that are no longer in use, improving system hygiene and maintainability.
tool_definitions.name: delete-feature-flag

tool_definitions.description: Retrieves details of a specific AI Config, including variations and model settings.
tool_definitions.name: get-ai-config

tool_definitions.description: Retrieves the targeting details of a specific AI Config, including individual targets, rules, and rollouts.
tool_definitions.name: get-ai-config-targeting

tool_definitions.description: Identifies which repositories have code references to a given flag, helping agents determine if they're operating on the correct repository and understand the scope of cleanup (single vs multi-repo).
tool_definitions.name: get-code-references

tool_definitions.description: Identifies which environments exist in a project and determines which are marked as "critical" (production, staging, etc.). Allows agents to programmatically identify critical environments instead of hardcoding assumptions.
tool_definitions.name: get-environments

tool_definitions.description: Fetches the full configuration for a specific feature flag, including environments, variations, and targeting rules. Useful for agents auditing or managing specific feature toggles in a detailed, contextual manner.
tool_definitions.name: get-feature-flag

tool_definitions.description: Returns lifecycle status (new, active, inactive, launched) based on actual usage patterns, evaluation counts, and configuration stability. This is the key intelligence for removal readiness assessment.
tool_definitions.name: get-flag-status-across-environments

tool_definitions.description: Retrieves AI configuration settings for a specific project. This endpoint allows agents to access and modify AI-related configurations, ensuring that the AI's behavior aligns with project requirements and user expectations.
tool_definitions.name: list-ai-configs

tool_definitions.description: Retrieves all feature flags within a project, including metadata and targeting rules. Enables AI agents to enumerate existing flags for inspection, configuration analysis, or generating flag usage reports across environments.
tool_definitions.name: list-feature-flags

tool_definitions.description: Updates metadata or configuration of an existing AI Config.
tool_definitions.name: update-ai-config

tool_definitions.description: Updates the targeting of an existing AI Config.
tool_definitions.name: update-ai-config-targeting

tool_definitions.description: Updates a specific variation within an AI Config. Enables fine-tuned control of model behavior.
tool_definitions.name: update-ai-config-variation

tool_definitions.description: Updates the configuration of an existing feature flag. Enables agents to change targeting rules, modify variations, or adapt rollout strategies dynamically in response to user behavior or experiment results.
tool_definitions.name: update-feature-flag
